text:
sara: Hey team — prepping evidence bundle for the SOC2+ISO fieldwork next week. Two immediate asks from the auditor: (A) show RBAC change approvals (including temporary elevation flows); (B) correlate KMS rotations/access to a vuln triage ticket. Can we collate and outline what we'll hand over?

devon: For RBAC changes we usually export the PR + merge approval thread + terraform plan diff. Short CLI to grab commit history: `git log --pretty=oneline -- path=infra/iam` — include the merge comment IDs. Also include Okta admin audit link.

tom: For temporary elevations we have the ephemeral-admin runbook and the approval audit screenshots. I can capture the screenshot sequence and a short writeup referencing the runbook step numbers.

maria: On KMS side: CloudTrail has RotateKey and ReEncrypt events; KMS has key metadata. I can produce a filtered export that maps events to ticket IDs (we tag rotations with `x-redwood:ticket=...`).

sara: @maria can you add the exact queries you'll run and a note on retention/chain-of-custody? Auditor asked about non-repudiation proof.

maria: sure — sample CloudTrail lookup: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2023-11-01 --end-time 2023-11-20``` and we cross-reference with KMS: ```aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[?starts_with(KeyId, `arn`)]'``` Then map `EventId` -> `x-redwood:ticket`.

devon: FYI the auditor will want approver UPNs and timestamps for RBAC approvals. Also include policy diff hashes (before/after) so they can verify integrity.

rene (auditor): Quick Q: will you provide a CSV extract with approver + approval_ts + resource_affected + link-to-evidence? Also please map each artifact to ISO control IDs (A.9.x) and SOC2 CC6/CC7 where applicable.

sara: Yes — we'll produce a CSV with columns: principal, role_changed, before_policy_hash, after_policy_hash, approver, approval_ts, approval_link. We'll add a control-mapping.csv that maps artifacts to control IDs and a short rationale column.

tom: For vuln triage linkage: add columns `vuln_ticket`, `pr`, `deployment_id`, `kms_rotation_id` (nullable). I'll script a join across JIRA -> Git -> deploys.

maria: I'll prepare two sanitized files: `kms-rotation-sample.json` (sanitized) and `cloudtrail-rotation-snapshot.log`. Note: we must redact IPs and user emails per PII policy before upload.

sara: Onchain: we also need a one-page incident timeline for any event we reference (UTC times, actions taken, owners). Oncall, confirm ephemeral key TTL and retention details so we can reference in timeline.

devon: ephemeral creds TTL = 1h by default (sts:AssumeRole with session duration 3600s). Logs go to `/var/log/redwood/auth` and CloudTrail; HSM wrap events stored in a locked S3 bucket with limited access. We'll include MD5 hashes for each exported artifact.

audit-bot: evidence-bundle-builder started. job id: eb-20231120-42. status: collecting artifacts. :package:

rene (auditor): Thanks. One more ask: for any redaction you perform, include an attestation file describing what was redacted and why, plus the redaction script used (sanitized). That lets us accept the bundle without requesting rework.

sara: Good point — we'll include `redaction-attestation.txt` and the sanitized `redaction.sh` script.

tom: Small blocker: I need temporary read access to the HSM logs bucket to pull the wrap logs. Can someone grant for 24 hours?

devon: granted — `tom` has s3:GetObject on `arn:aws:s3:::redwood-hsm-logs/*` until `1700080000`. Check the IAM console.

maria: I'll scrub PII before upload and note the scrub steps in the attestation. Also I'll add the mapping doc that links `EventId` -> `CloudTrail` -> `KMSKeyId` -> `Ticket`.

sara: Perfect. Action items: (1) maria/tom/devon to assemble artifacts and scripts by EOD tomorrow; (2) sara to produce control-mapping.csv; (3) audit-bot to produce initial manifest and hash index. Anything else?

tom: I'll open a small PR that adds the manifest JSON template to `security/evidence/manifest.template.json` so reviewers can see expected fields.

sara: Awesome — tagging this thread into the audit handoff doc. :ballot_box_with_check:
